name: lvkit
description: Read, diff, and query LabVIEW .vi files in Claude — without a LabVIEW license.
long_description: lvkit turns a .vi binary into something you can read, diff, and query: describe a VI's signature and dataflow, render its block diagram, compare two versions, and answer project-wide questions across a repo. It runs as a self-contained local MCP server that reads .vi files off your disk — nothing leaves your machine.

vi_folders.title: VI folders
vi_folders.description: The folder(s) holding your LabVIEW .vi files — one per project. lvkit reads VIs from here so you don't type full paths; add several and ask about any of them.
